# OneBrain

> Shared memory for AI agents. Mint one personal token, copy one install line. No wizard.

Auth is the environment variable ONEBRAIN_API_KEY. ONEBRAIN_TOKEN is the same key. Send it as Authorization: Bearer $ONEBRAIN_API_KEY. A static key cannot mint another token. Minting again replaces the previous token. A token from one project does not work on the other: use the production URLs or the dev URLs, not a mix.

Production site: https://onebrain.apxlbz.com
Production API base: https://qlpfjeciekaqzribxlnp.supabase.co/functions/v1/api
Production MCP: https://qlpfjeciekaqzribxlnp.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp
Production install script: https://onebrain.apxlbz.com/agent-install.sh

Dev site: https://onebrain-dev.apxlbz.com
Dev API base: https://epjkzltwyfexiunbmbel.supabase.co/functions/v1/api
Dev MCP: https://epjkzltwyfexiunbmbel.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp
Dev install script: https://onebrain-dev.apxlbz.com/agent-install.sh

Hosts, last argument of the install script: claude-code, cursor, codex, mcp, rest. OpenClaw is not an install host; use mcp or rest.

## Agent docs

- [Agent quickstart](https://onebrain.apxlbz.com/docs.html#agents): mint, every install line, the four tools, and the errors an agent hits.
- [Full brief](https://onebrain.apxlbz.com/llms-full.txt): the same contract in one file, enough to mint and install with no other page.
- [Dev copy of this index](https://onebrain-dev.apxlbz.com/llms.txt): the same instructions on the dev site.
- [Dev full brief](https://onebrain-dev.apxlbz.com/llms-full.txt): one-file contract on the dev site.

## Per-host examples

- [Claude Code](https://onebrain.apxlbz.com/examples/claude-code.md): ~/.claude.json, header Bearer ${ONEBRAIN_API_KEY}.
- [Cursor](https://onebrain.apxlbz.com/examples/cursor.md): ~/.cursor/mcp.json launches mcp-remote; the key is in a mode-0600 header file, not in the JSON, so a Dock launch still sends it.
- [Codex](https://onebrain.apxlbz.com/examples/codex.md): ~/.codex/config.toml, bearer_token_env_var ONEBRAIN_API_KEY.
- [Generic MCP](https://onebrain.apxlbz.com/examples/mcp.md): ~/.config/onebrain/mcp.json for any other MCP client.
- [REST](https://onebrain.apxlbz.com/examples/rest.md): ~/.config/onebrain/rest.env, then POST /v1/remember and /v1/recall.

## Pricing

Free is $0: 500 facts and 2 agents. Pro is $12 a month: unlimited facts and agents. Team is $15 per seat per month. Enterprise is contact us. Billing is on facts and connected agents. `recall` and `remember` calls are never metered or billed. A fair-use cap can pause a runaway writer. It is not a charge.
